sample_accuracy_notes: Samples create billable infrastructure in the user's subscription (pools of 2 to 10 dedicated VMs, autoscale formulas, recurring job schedules) and do not mention cost. A reviewer should know an agent may scaffold this.

Samples run remote commands with elevated rights on the user's pool nodes ('apt-get install' as ADMIN start task, a 'sudo apt-get update' task). That is the purpose of Azure Batch and runs on the user's VMs, not the agent's machine.
The pool image pairs offer 'UbuntuServer' with SKU '22_04-lts', which does not exist; other samples correctly use '0001-com-ubuntu-server-jammy'. Exit-code samples use 'cmd /c' on a Linux pool.
waitForPoolReady loops forever if allocation fails.
